about: QA-403 (P-486, the tech lead's ruling 11 Nov ~23:5x IST, reversible): facts the firm or the case already knows are never asked of the client; the case officer sets them, in plain words. Data, not code (P-319): the configured checkpoint (api/src/features/checkpoint/097-who-fills.ts) changes who fills each question below through the product's own route (Library › a field › Change who fills, C4.9: the author proposes with the reason, a second person (the content reviewer) approves on To review, it goes out with the next release), and gives its question and its help the words below through the placement route (Library › Fields › placement). A question in a background or declarations section is never moved (P-97): the route refuses it. These are the firm's own facts about its filing, not immigration values: no IRCC value is set here.

questions.question: Does this Use of a Representative form (IMM 5476) appoint the representative, or cancel an appointment? Write appoint or cancel
questions.help: Why we ask: IMM 5476 has one box for appointing a representative and one for cancelling. Your firm knows which; the client is not asked.
questions.reason: QA-403 (P-486): the firm's own filing; the firm knows whether it appoints or cancels, so the client is not asked.

questions.question: Which kind of application is this case: visitor, worker or student? For any other kind, leave it and tick the form's Other box by hand
questions.help: Why we ask: IMM 5475, IMM 5476 and IMM 5645 name the kind of application. It follows from the case's pathway; the client is not asked. The forms' own words for it are visitor, worker and student; any other word is written by hand.
questions.reason: QA-403 (P-486): the kind of application follows from the case's pathway, which the firm chose; the client is not asked.

questions.question: Which IRCC office has the application, if it was already submitted? For a new application, pass this line on Ready to file with the reason "new application"
questions.help: Why we ask: IMM 5475 and IMM 5476 ask for the office only when the application was already sent. Your firm sends it; the client is not asked. For a new application there is no office yet: on Ready to file, pass this line with the reason "new application".
questions.reason: QA-403 (P-486): the firm submits the application and knows the office; the client is not asked.
